phrases.request: May I borrow your {item} from {start} to {end}?
phrases.cancel: Sorry, I'd like to cancel this request.
phrases.accept: Yes, please go ahead! I'll hand it over at the {spot} on {start}.
phrases.decline: Sorry, I can't lend it this time.
phrases.declineBusy: Sorry, I need to use it myself on those days.
phrases.handoverPhoto: I took a photo of the {item} before handing it over. Please check its condition.
phrases.received: I've received the {item}. I'll take good care of it.
phrases.returned: I'm returning the {item}. It really helped — thank you so much!
phrases.returnConfirmed: I've got the {item} back. Thank you! Feel free to ask anytime.
phrases.qr.late: Sorry, I'm running a little late.
phrases.sys.dueSoon: Reminder: please return the {item} by {end} at the {spot}.
phrases.sys.overdue: Reminder: the {item} was due back by {end}. Please return it to {name} as soon as you can.
phrases.sys.overdueLender: We've sent {name} a polite reminder about your {item}, so you don't have to.
phrases.pingNeedBack: Sorry to bother you — {name} will need the {item} back soon. Could you return it at the {spot} when convenient?
phrases.pingOverdue: Friendly reminder from {name}: the {item} was due back by {end}. Could you please return it at the {spot} soon?
phrases.sys.expired: Your request for the {item} expired because the requested time passed. You can ask again anytime.
phrases.issue.missingOrBroken: I noticed a part of the {item} seems missing or not working properly. Let's check it together.
phrases.issue.damaged: Sorry — the {item} may have been damaged. Could we check it together at the {spot}?
phrases.stamp.bigThanks: 🙇 Thank you so much for lending the {item}!
phrases.stamp.clean: ✨ Returned clean and ready for next time!
phrases.stamp.snack: 🍪 Left a small thank-you treat for you!

tips.beforeRequest: Tip: in Japan, it's polite to return things clean and on time. A small thank-you snack is a nice touch, but never required.
tips.atHandover: Tip: a short bow and "arigatou gozaimasu" goes a long way.
tips.atReturn: Tip: if you'll be late, tap "Sorry, I'm running a little late." before the due time — it's much better than silence.
tips.forLender: Your neighbor may speak a different language. Don't worry — Otonari shows everything in their language.
